source: HTR (kraken, seg_geniza/htr_geniza models) + forced alignment against the local diplomatic Vienna transcription, MS Vienna (Austrian National Library, Cod. hebr. 20). Images: Sefaria's hosted copies of the same scans (manuscripts.sefaria.org/vienna-tosefta), matched to our processed pages by canon-range overlap (not a page-number formula) -- see vienna_emit_site_data.py docstring. bbox is in the source image pixel coordinates [x0,y0,x1,y1]; Sefaria's image is confirmed to be the same photograph at effectively the same resolution, so no rescale is applied. chapters[perek] is keyed by baseIdx (same index as data/witnesses' witnesses["ב"].words -- Vienna is the site's base text), re-aligned from this pipeline's own sequential Vienna word list via difflib, same method as erfurt_emit_site_data.py.
